raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly mapped the target relationship, stating that to find Princess Augusta’s paternal grandmother they needed George II’s grandmother (the mother of George I). This conflated “paternal grandmother” (mother of Augusta’s father, George II) with a generation higher, leading to the wrong identification (Christiane Henriette) instead of the correct paternal grandmother, Princess Augusta (Auguste) of Schwarzburg-Sondershausen.
